html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · October 28, 2022

On Oct 26, 2022, social-commerce ToB SaaS Yiben Market (一本集市) closed a $2M Series A from GGV Capital (纪源资本) for product R&D, owned service offices, and national coverage. Founded Oct 2017; SaaS + PaaS (“Yiben Cloud”) across electronics, FMCG, beauty, mother-baby, retail, education, F&B — pre/mid/post-sale, supply chain, catalog, orders, warehouse, CS, marketing. Unified WeChat/Alipay mini-program + H5 + APP; front sales / mid finance / back supply modules for O2O. Positioned among the most multi-platform-connected China ecom SaaS vendors.

— END —
